exposure: admission of newborn to care unit
type of infant feeding at discharge
perception of adequate respect from health professionals
cohort: The study included 2627 women (1752 in the referral cohort and 875 in the validation cohort) who gave birth in Spain between 2018 and 2019.
finding: A predictive model (Model B) incorporating clinical variables, partner support, and perception of respect from health professionals demonstrated superior predictive capacity for postpartum PTSD risk compared to a model based solely on clinical variables (Model A).
mod_finding: Delivery type was identified as a predictive factor included in both models for postpartum PTSD risk.
